responsibility: This header declares the theme abstraction that separates text-art layout from glyph choice. It defines the stable enumeration of abstract cell kinds used by rulers, borders, arrows, interprocedural traces, CFGs, and tree renderers, along with the virtual API for ASCII, Unicode, and emoji-capable themes to report capabilities and provide the concrete characters or styled cells used when painting to a canvas.
same_name_distinction: Declares the abstract theme interface, cell_kind vocabulary, and concrete theme classes; unlike gcc/text-art/theme.cc, it does not provide the actual ASCII/Unicode glyph mapping logic.
